# Blode Icons

> Beautifully crafted SVG icons for React — MIT licensed, Lucide-compatible, tree-shakeable.

Blode Icons is a curated icon set distributed as `blode-icons-react` on npm. Every icon ships as a React component with outline and filled variants. Agents can search and fetch icons via MCP or the HTTP API.

## License

MIT — free for personal and commercial use. No attribution required.

## Install

```bash
npm install blode-icons-react
```

Agent skill (optional):

```bash
npx skills add mblode/blode-icons -g --all -y
```

## Usage

Prefer named imports from the package root. Full-library exports use the `Icon` suffix. Lucide-style aliases (no suffix) are also exported for drop-in replacement:

```tsx
import { SearchIcon, Search, type LucideProps } from "blode-icons-react";
import AirplaneIcon from "blode-icons-react/icons/airplane";
import { DynamicIcon } from "blode-icons-react/dynamic";

<SearchIcon size={24} />
<Search size={20} color="currentColor" strokeWidth={1.5} />
<DynamicIcon name="SearchIcon" size={24} />
```

## Agent tools

- MCP server: https://blode.co/icons/mcp
- MCP discovery: https://blode.co/icons/.well-known/mcp.json
- MCP server card: https://blode.co/icons/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json
- Search API: `GET https://blode.co/icons/api/icons/search?q=settings`
- Icon SVG: `GET https://blode.co/icons/api/icons/{slug}/svg`
- Icon TSX: `GET https://blode.co/icons/api/icons/{slug}/tsx`
- OpenAPI: https://blode.co/icons/api/openapi.json
- Skills index: https://blode.co/icons/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json
- shadcn registry: https://blode.co/icons/r/registry.json

## MCP tools

1. `search_icons` — fuzzy search by name, tag, category, or Lucide alias
2. `get_icon` — fetch SVG and/or React TSX plus a ready-to-paste import (license: MIT)
